text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Buena Vista!
Buena Vista is turning on the jets!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose... because I made a promise!
I'm going to take everyone to see that view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Toward my, toward our... "breathtaking view"—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —A breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see it, Buena-san...!
The light called thirst burning inside your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Until this very moment, I didn't realize.
I thought you were running solely to meet everyone's expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Still... I was wrong!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You too are running by your own will
toward the scenery you strive to reach!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, you too!
You were aiming for a place beyond here, just like me—...!!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The running of my comrades sets this soul ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us proceed!
To even greater heights—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A true clash of wills! Which one of them will grasp the Tiara first?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista crosses the finish line now--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Buenaaaaa!!
I knew you could win it!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your first crown!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: “Buena Vistaaaa!!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers for Buena Vista
showed no sign of ever stopping.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, fufu... Fufufufu!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You were wonderful, Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: As I am right now, it's still not enough...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Gaining greater strength with overwhelming running!
I must defeat Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "that place" is still so far away...
The Saint's journey has only just begun...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Good work, Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san... you have my utmost gratitude.
That was a truly magnificent run."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask you one thing?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I would like to hear about it.
The "magnificent view" that you strive for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...There's a view that I want to see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A strong, dazzling, and glorious vision of victory.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes and dreams of countless people—
A boundless place we want to reach together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That is... the "breathtaking view" we promised
to strive for with someone so dear to us.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm always searching
for dreamlike scenery.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I heard my grandpa was a bit of a dreamer.
Hehe... maybe I took after him, you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My... I've heard that my grandfather, too...
was a dreamer who endlessly chased distant ideals.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what a coincidence...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...No. This is--

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: An imprint bearing the name "Destiny."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Our birth into this world, our meeting, and the moments we sprint across the turf together... Every single piece of it was destined to be."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Though our ways of being differ,
we are kindred spirits, harboring a thirst
that 'this present view' can never satisfy...—”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Being captivated by the word 'destiny'
is probably something I inherited from my grandpa, too."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we ran an amazing race today,
but... we're still striving for more. Right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My heart is not yet satisfied...
This soul is yearning for more, even stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
An exquisite ordeal with you—
one even hotter, even more thrilling—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm glad! I want to run with you too, as an even stronger version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even in the next Oaks, I will run ahead of you.
And I will reach my goal.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I shall reach that peak as well.

text_block_list.name: Desire & Buena
text_block_list.text:
"To the 'Otherworld'—!
To the 'Spectacular View'—!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...And that is how it is!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Buena-san in the Triple Tiara campaign
is truly the only key to reaching the alternate realm.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"—I have become reasonably convinced
that this is the way to satisfy my heart."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Quickly brushing aside any lingering regrets from the Oka Sho, Red Desire was already looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that she has gained the ultimate rival in Buena Vista,
Red Desire's morale is soaring.
—Then there's no need to hesitate.
choice_data_list: Let's get in peak condition for the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next race, the Oaks,
leads into a deeper abyss—the uncharted 2400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Facing the increasingly grueling trials ahead, as her Trainer, I straightened my posture and vowed to make thorough preparations.
